records.name: AI & Advanced Computing
records.notes: Lead confirmed on https://www.schmidtsciences.org/team as of 2026-05-29. Mike Belinsky listed as Director, AI & Advanced Computing.

records.name: Science Systems
records.notes: Lead confirmed on https://www.schmidtsciences.org/team as of 2026-05-29. James Ricci listed as Director, Science Systems. NOTE: 'Science Systems' is the canonical name for this division (not 'Health' as the PR summary mistakenly stated). Schmidt Futures rebranded to Schmidt Sciences in 2024; schmidtfutures.org redirects to schmidtsciences.org.

records.name: Climate
records.notes: Lead confirmed on https://www.schmidtsciences.org/team as of 2026-05-29. Heidi Cullen listed as Director, Climate. NOTE: 'Climate' is the canonical name for this division (not 'Earth & Environment' as the PR summary mistakenly stated). Schmidt Sciences has five program areas: AI & Advanced Computing, Astrophysics & Space, Biosciences, Climate, and Science Systems.
